summary: Visible tip risks from unanchored tall items and fragile objects within toddler reach.

hazards.title: Tall Plant Tip Risk
hazards.detail: Tall tree in basket can easily tip over onto a child or pets if bumped.
fixSteps: Anchor base or place planter into a heavier, wide base container.
Tether the upper trunk to a discrete wall anchor.

hazards.title: Fragile Tall Vase on Table
hazards.detail: Tall thin vase on low table is easily grabbed or knocked over by children.
fixSteps: Move breakable vase to higher surface out of reach.
Secure base with museum wax if keeping on table.

hazards.title: Unanchored Credenza Cabinet
hazards.detail: Low sideboard cabinet is not visibly wall-anchored and poses a tip hazard.
fixSteps: Fasten anti-tip wall brackets to wall studs.
Install magnetic child safety latches on cabinet doors.

hazards.title: Loose Table Decor & Candle
hazards.detail: Small decor and candle are accessible reach hazards for toddlers.
fixSteps: Relocate candle and small items to high shelves.
Keep low table surfaces clear of swallowable objects.
